summary: Pulaski High School is a public high school in Pulaski, Wisconsin, located in Brown County, serving students in grades 9 through 12. Its school district also serves parts of Shawano, Outagamie and Oconto counties. The school's mascot is the Red Raider.
one_line: Pulaski High School is a public high school in Pulaski, Wisconsin, serving grades 9-12 with the Red Raider mascot.
